zh.headline: Anthropic 联合创始人回应 IPO 疑虑
zh.observation: 今天最值得关注的信号是 AI 产业的“分水岭”效应：一方面，Microsoft 与 OpenAI 从合作走向竞争，Anthropic 准备 IPO，顶级 AI 公司开始寻求独立于合作伙伴的生态地位；另一方面，从帐篷数据中心到 token 压缩工具，整个行业正在疯狂追求基础设施的降本增效。与此同时，AI 安全与监管（生物武器防护联名信）以及 AI 对就业的冲击（GitLab 裁员）正在成为不可忽视的公共议题。对于开发者而言，**Agent 操作系统（Astrid）和代码知识图谱（Codegraph）等新兴基础设施的涌现，预示着 AI 应用开发范式正在发生根本性转变。**

en.headline: Anthropic Co-founder Addresses IPO Doubts
en.observation: The most notable signal today is the "watershed" effect in the AI industry: on one hand, Microsoft and OpenAI move from partnership to competition, Anthropic prepares for an IPO, and top AI companies seek independent ecosystem positions; on the other hand, from tent data centers to token compression tools, the entire industry is manically pursuing infrastructure cost reduction. Meanwhile, AI safety and regulation (bioweapon letter) and AI's impact on employment (GitLab layoffs) are becoming unavoidable public issues. For developers, the emergence of new infrastructure like **agent operating systems (Astrid) and code knowledge graphs (Codegraph)** signals a fundamental shift in the AI application development paradigm.
